thread:
mira (PM): quick sync — saw a couple new post-launch issues. can we triage bug vs enhancement? perf regression on streaming, one UX copy nit, and an embedding mismatch reported by Acme. thinking quick decisions and owners. ⏱️

alex (Eng): on it. can you paste repro steps or the Acme note? i'll start with infra checks. @jordan fyi.

chris (Customer Success): Acme sent a sample convo and said embeddings 'shifted' vs last week. link: https://redwood.app/notes/ACME-embed-1 (they're blocked on rollout)

alex (Eng): got the sample. looks like differences consistent with a model-quantization variant. did we promote any model yesterday?

mira (PM): we rolled a tiny optimizer change at ~03:12 UTC (non-model). rollout-bot shows a model promotion though — need confirm. @deploy-bot any model promos around 03:10?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion: model-xq-1.3 -> promoted to canary -> 2026-03-15 03:10 UTC

sam (SWE): if model-xq changed, embedding vectors can shift. options: revert to model-xq-1.2 canary (fast, ~30m churn) or hotfix with re-quantize profile (longer). which do we want?

jordan (SRE): infra looks healthy. p99 latency spike lines up with an autoscaling/batching tweak at 03:05 (auto-batch size 8 -> 4). i can roll batching back now to previous policy. that should address latency.

mira (PM): proposal for triage rules: 1) customer-blocking embedding diffs = P0 bug / hotfix. 2) perf regressions affecting SLA = bug. 3) copy/UX = enhancement backlog. everyone ok?

chris (Customer Success): :thumbsup: Acme says embedding parity is blocking prod rollout. they want a fix asap — mark P0.

alex (Eng): i'll open a revert PR for the model routing (roll back to model-xq-1.2 canary) and run the embedding integration test locally. assigning to me. ETA ~45m.

sam (SWE): i'll create a follow-up backlog ticket for improving post-deploy embedding validation in CI (daily run, diff threshold, alert). not blocking hotfix.

mira (PM): sam — please add acceptance criteria: run daily against customer baseline, threshold 1e-3 L2 norm, alert to #product on breach. put into next sprint as 'near-term backlog'.

jordan (SRE): i'll rollback batching in dev & promote to staging. @alex ping me when PR is ready and i'll coordinate canary. command i'll run: `./infra/ops adjust-batching --policy previous`

alex (Eng): PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/8421 — revert model routing. running integration tests, will post results here.

triage-bot: triage-bot: Created ticket RDW-5678 'Acme embedding parity regression' assigned to alex, priority P0.

mira (PM): recap: P0 = embedding parity -> alex hotfix PR. perf spike -> jordan rollback batching (in progress). copy/UX = enhancement -> sam to backlog with clear AC. reconvene in 1h or earlier if PRs land. thanks all!
